system.description:
• Effect: Your patron's power is one pool of favour: 1 use a day at 1st level, 2 at 4th and 3 at 8th. Spend a use on your signature blast, a Path gift, an Eldritch Strike or anything else that costs Patron Favour; a power that is always on costs nothing.
  • When you spend your last Patron Favour of the day, the GM may name a small service your patron expects before it returns.

4th level:

2 uses a day

8th level:

3 uses a day
